requirement:
After a rejection under {cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection`,
a submission whose `rationale` is exactly the UUID that rejection gave MUST
resolve to the rejected submission unchanged, ignoring the new submission's
other fields; acceptance remains subject to
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`. After passing that gate, any other rationale that cites line numbers MUST fail
the assessment, so
an assessment rejects at most one submission. The UUID MUST NOT be recorded in
evidence.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation of `requirements.authoring.line_numbers.resubmission`. I did not request implementation source. I judged the tests from the requirement text and the supplied test bodies.

- **Exact-UUID resubmission keeps the rejected submission unchanged and ignores the new fields.**
  - `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rejection_gives_a_uuid_that_keeps_the_rejected_submission]` extracts the UUID from the rejection message. It resubmits with a different determination and `rationale` set to the UUID. It asserts that `rejection.resubmitted(&keep)` equals `Some(cited)`, the whole original submission. So the new determination is ignored.
  - The same test asserts that the UUID followed by a trailing space does not resolve. This confirms the match must be exact.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]` runs the full `assess` flow. Its first case sends the UUID with a different determination and asserts the evidence rationale equals the original cited rationale.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[search_gate_preserves_line_number_correction_and_uuid_resubmission]` asserts `Judgment::False` and the original rationale after `RetainRejected`.
- **Acceptance is subject to the outstanding-search gate.** `search_gate_preserves_line_number_correction_and_uuid_resubmission` does the following:
  - It submits a line-number rationale while a search is outstanding. The result mentions outstanding searches and not "rationale set to exactly". This shows the gate comes first and the rejection and its resubmission are not consumed.
  - It resubmits the same rationale after the search is finished. The rejection with the UUID now appears.
  - It sends a UUID resubmission while another search is outstanding. The result again mentions outstanding searches.
  - After that search is finished, the UUID resubmission is accepted.
- **After the gate, any other rationale citing line numbers fails the assessment, so at most one submission is rejected.**
  - `a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once` has a third case where a second citing rationale fails with an error containing "after a rejection". Its second case shows that a clean rationale replaces the rejected one.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_second_line_number_rationale_fails_only_after_searches_are_finished]` shows the second citing rationale is held back by the outstanding-search gate. It then fails with "after a rejection" once the searches are finished. It also checks that the gated attempt's accompanying calls were not run and that no determination is recorded.
  - The unit test in `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs` checks `Outcome::Fail` for a repeated citing rationale.
- **The UUID MUST NOT be recorded in evidence.** In `a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once`, the accepted cases assert that the serialized evidence does not match a UUID-prefix regex. This includes the UUID-keep case.

The tests are marked with `{test}` references to the subject. I found no unaddressed input class that the text distinguishes.

When the only submission in a response under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission`, or a `submit_verification` call under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.verifier_prompt`, is otherwise valid but its
rationale cites line numbers under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.detection`, and it is the
assessment's first such submission, and it passes the outstanding-search gate
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`, the
harness MUST reject it instead of
accepting it and continue the conversation. The tool result MUST quote the
matched text, repeat the location guidance of
{cite}`requirements.authoring.judgment_rules`, and give a fresh random UUID,
saying the model may submit once more, either without line numbers or with
`rationale` set to exactly that UUID to keep the rejected submission as it was.
A rejection MUST be counted in usage like any other turn.
:::{req} submission.searches.line_numbers
After validating submission arguments or resolving the UUID resubmission
form, the outstanding-search gate MUST precede line-number rejection or
acceptance. An outstanding-search rejection MUST NOT consume the line-number
resubmission or submission reminder.
